imi.title: How the activities felt
imi.cite: Adapted from the Intrinsic Motivation Inventory (McAuley, Duncan & Tammen, 1989).

items.text: I enjoyed playing the COMPGame activities very much.
I think I did pretty well at these activities.
I put a lot of effort into the activities.
I believe these activities are useful for learning HCI concepts.
The activities were fun to do.
After working through the activities, I felt fairly competent with the topics.
It was important to me to do well at these activities.
I think doing these activities could help me in my studies.
I found the activities boring.
I was satisfied with how I performed in the games and quizzes.
I didn't try very hard to do well at these activities.
I would be willing to learn this way again because it has value for me.

coi.title: The game and the tutor as your teacher
coi.cite: Community of Inquiry, reworded (instructor -> game + AI tutor). Non-validated adaptation; exploratory.

items.text: The game and AI tutor clearly communicated what each topic was about and what I was meant to learn.
The game and AI tutor gave clear instructions on how to take part in each activity.
The game and AI tutor helped keep me focused and on-task while I was learning.
The feedback from the game and AI tutor helped me see what I understood and what I still needed to work on.
I felt comfortable interacting with the game and AI tutor.
I felt comfortable asking the AI tutor questions and trying things out in the games.
Interacting with the game and AI tutor felt like a genuine back-and-forth, not a one-way lecture.
I felt that what I did was acknowledged — the game and AI tutor responded to my actions.

arcs.title: How satisfied you were
arcs.cite: ARCS-S (Keller). Null result expected and pre-registered as such.

items.text: Completing the activities gave me a satisfying feeling of accomplishment.
I enjoyed these activities so much that I would like to learn more this way.
It was a pleasure to work through such well-designed activities.
I felt good when I completed an assessment successfully.
The variety of games, challenges, and feedback helped hold my interest.
Overall, I am satisfied with this learning experience.
I would recommend this way of learning to other students.
If COMPGame were available for my courses, I would choose to use it.
